verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for an email-delivery SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack only mentions "open-source SDKs" (sendgrid-docs-20), which are client libraries, not the SendGrid service itself. No evidence shows the product's own source is published under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
